The '''gasan string drum''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument commonly used in [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]]. Notable string drum players include [[Figrin D'an/Legends|Figrin D'an]], leader of the [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Modal Nodes]].

==Behind the Scenes==
Based on its sound, the gasan string drum was likely recorded as a steelpan, a melodic percussion instrument originating from Trinidad and Tobago. All of the instruments played by the Modal Nodes have real life counterparts made easily identifiable through their sound.{{Music-stub}}
